product_type: Fleet safety, transport management and logistics workflow digitalisation
description: Lorry System provides AI dashcams and driver safety monitoring, GPS fleet telematics and Transport Management System workflows. Additional offerings include configured live vehicle/cargo cameras, consolidation and multi-drop delivery, and scoped fleet administration. Plant/weighbridge, waste transport and integration solutions are custom implementations subject to requirements. Fuel sensors, TPMS and alcohol detectors are not promoted until availability and supported configurations are confirmed. No guaranteed improvements, savings or deployment coverage are promised.
target_customers: Proposed Malaysian segments: transport/haulage; 3PL; manufacturers, distributors and retailers; premix/quarry/concrete/construction materials; waste/environmental services; bus/passenger operators; high-value/sensitive cargo transport. Segment by operational need and verified buying authority. Fleet size is not an eligibility threshold. Subcontract-only operators can fit TMS; camera/telematics installation requires owned, leased or authorised vehicles. Record existing systems and their documented gaps; do not infer demand from existing GPS use.
discovery_query: Malaysia transport haulage logistics 3PL distribution bus quarry concrete waste collection company

products.name: AI dashcams and driver safety monitoring
products.description: ADAS road safety alerts; DMS fatigue and distraction monitoring; two-channel and four-channel camera configurations; incident photos and videos. Intended problems: Unsafe driving, limited incident evidence, disputed accident claims, and difficulty monitoring driver behaviour. Do not promise guaranteed safety, savings or improvements; establish the existing system and specific unmet gap first.

products.name: GPS tracking and fleet telematics
products.description: Vehicle location, journey history, overspeed alerts, driving event monitoring, and fleet visibility through web and mobile platforms. Intended problems: Limited visibility of vehicle movements, unauthorised use, and difficulty supervising distributed fleets. Do not promise guaranteed safety, savings or improvements; establish the existing system and specific unmet gap first.

products.name: Live vehicle and cargo monitoring
products.description: Live streaming, playback, intercom, and additional cameras for side, rear, or cargo visibility, depending on configuration. Intended problems: Cargo security concerns, delivery disputes, and difficulty verifying events during transit. Do not promise guaranteed safety, savings or improvements; establish the existing system and specific unmet gap first.

products.name: Transport Management System (TMS)
products.description: Quotation, order management, trip assignment, driver and operator apps, electronic proof of delivery, invoicing, dashboards, and master data. Intended problems: Disconnected transport processes, manual dispatching, missing delivery documents, and delayed billing. Do not promise guaranteed safety, savings or improvements; establish the existing system and specific unmet gap first.

products.name: Consolidation and multi-drop delivery management
products.description: Collection-to-warehouse workflows, consolidation planning, regional delivery assignment, multi-drop jobs, and end-to-end booking traceability. Intended problems: Difficulty tracking shipments across collection, warehouse handling, and final delivery. Do not promise guaranteed safety, savings or improvements; establish the existing system and specific unmet gap first.

products.name: Fleet and driver administration
products.description: Vehicle checklists, attendance, incident records, maintenance tracking, permit and inspection records, driver incentives, and trip expenses, according to project scope. Intended problems: Fragmented records, missed renewals, inconsistent inspections, and poor visibility of operating costs. Do not promise guaranteed safety, savings or improvements; establish the existing system and specific unmet gap first.

products.name: Plant and weighbridge logistics digitalisation
products.description: Custom workflows covering orders, truck arrival, queues, loading, weighing, dockets, delivery status, and customer notifications. Intended problems: Heavy reliance on WhatsApp, repeated data entry, loading errors, and limited visibility across plant operations. Custom implementation, subject to project requirements and scope; not a confirmed standard deployment-ready product. Do not promise guaranteed safety, savings or improvements; establish the existing system and specific unmet gap first.

products.name: Waste collection and transport workflow systems
products.description: Custom customer portals, orders, credit-check workflows, manifests, fleet records, driver incentives, expenses, and dashboards. Intended problems: Disconnected collection records, manual manifest handling, and limited coordination between customers and operations. Custom implementation, subject to project requirements and scope; not a confirmed standard deployment-ready product. Do not promise guaranteed safety, savings or improvements; establish the existing system and specific unmet gap first.

products.name: Custom logistics workflow automation and integration
products.description: Customer portals, operational dashboards, automated notifications, and interfaces with existing systems, subject to requirements. Intended problems: Repetitive communication, duplicate data entry, and operational information spread across multiple systems. Custom implementation, subject to project requirements and scope; not a confirmed standard deployment-ready product.
